sourceAnchors.claim: textbox reads scenario messages from Data SD2 as 256-byte Str255 slots and displays bytes 1..length.
Scenario messages can become notes/journal entries through the n/autonote path.
Two-choice prompt labels use Data OD 25-byte slots when present and Data SD2 fallback otherwise; first visible character becomes the shortcut.
First-start copies Data ED with four 80-byte buffers into CE and Data ED2 with nine 40-byte buffers into CE2.
Simple encounter runtime reads four 80-byte buffers, passes them to ParamText, and displays the prompt through Data SD2.
Opcode 4/5 encounter actions branch through encounter action/result rows, not inline text punctuation.
Encounter state saves target generated CE/CE2 runtime caches.
The string editor writes Data SD2 message slots directly as 256-byte records.

notes: 0 is no message in several runtime paths
negative IDs can suppress textbox click-wait in class -1 display path
messages can be marked as notes/journal entries

editorImplications: Make Text the central editable message workbench.
Encounter inline text should be labeled display text, not active scripting syntax.
Prompt message search controls should behave as target pickers for Data SD2 IDs.
Keep Data OD as optional two-choice prompt evidence and expose fallback to Data SD2.
Write encounter edits to source Data ED/Data ED2, not generated CE/CE2.
validationReady: Data SD2 messages must fit 255 encoded bytes.
Simple encounter display buffers must fit 80 bytes.
Complex encounter display buffers must fit 40 bytes.
Simple encounter source tails should be preserved until Data ED packing/tail evidence is resolved.
Prompt IDs should resolve to Data SD2 records unless preserved raw.
Two-choice prompt shortcuts should not collide.
Visible encounter display text with no action/result should warn as inert.
needsDivinityEvidence: Whether leading punctuation in encounter text is editor annotation or pure authored copy.
Divinity labels for simple/complex encounter text buffers.
Data OD authoring UI and fallback rules.
